name: BMW M6 Tuned
description:
This tuned BMW M6 takes the E63's legendary S85 V10 engine to the next level. Through extensive modifications including ported cylinder heads, aggressive camshafts, individual throttle bodies, and a complete exhaust system overhaul, power has been increased to 620 horsepower and 635 Nm of torque.

Weight reduction measures including stripped interior, carbon fiber panels, and lightweight wheels bring the total mass down to 1,615 kg. The suspension has been fully upgraded with adjustable coilovers, stiffer anti-roll bars, and track-oriented geometry.

The result is a track-focused weapon that maintains the intoxicating V10 soundtrack while delivering significantly improved performance over the stock M6.
author: PedroBLR
